findings.title: VMware ESXi 8.0 Update 3m Release Notes
findings.summary_md: Broadcom's release notes identify VMware ESXi 8.0 Update 3m as build 25926933 and date it 19 November 2026. The page tells administrators to check for additions and updates to the notes. The indexed text does not name CVE-2026-123910 or CVE-2026-123903.

findings.title: VMware ESXi: ESXi 8.0 Update 3m fixes · Version ESXi 8.0 U3m - 25926933 · Released 2026-11-20
findings.summary_md: UpdateAlert records ESXi 8.0 Update 3m build 25926933 as released on 20 November 2026. It says the build is distributed as an x86_64 ISO and an offline bundle. Applying it requires a host reboot and migration or shutdown of virtual machines.

findings.title: Support Content Notification - Support Portal - Broadcom support portal
findings.summary_md: Broadcom's VMSA-2026-0011 advisory covers VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion and Avi Load Balancer. The support page carries notification ID 39626 and was last updated 24 November 2026. The indexed advisory heading presents it as a multiple-vulnerability update for those product families.
